name: Alexandru Lefter
goals:
Improve reaction time in games
Win more ranked matches
Get real-time info without clutter
frustrations:
Too much info on screen
Hard to track enemies
Slow reaction under pressure
scenarios:
Alex Popescu is a 21-year-old computer science student living in Iași. He spends a large part of his free time playing competitive mobile games like Call of Duty: Mobile and PUBG Mobile, usually in ranked matches with friends.

He plays daily, especially in the evenings after classes, using his phone and occasionally gaming accessories to improve performance. Alex enjoys the competitive aspect of these games and is constantly trying to improve his reaction time, awareness, and overall ranking.

During intense matches, he often feels overwhelmed by the amount of information on the screen. He sometimes misses important cues—like enemy footsteps or nearby threats—which leads to frustration, especially when it costs him a match.

Alex is open to using new technology if it gives him a real advantage, but he does not want anything that distracts him or forces him to look away from the game for too long. He values quick, clear, and actionable information that can be understood at a glance.

A smartwatch companion app fits naturally into his routine because it provides subtle, real-time support without cluttering his main screen. For Alex, the ideal solution is something that enhances his gameplay without interrupting his focus.
otherDetails:
Plays daily (1–3 hours),
Competitive mindset,
Uses gaming accessories
